title: The Stop check uses the contract test command for a package in a subdirectory
body:
Why: Probe P0: a single package under packages/<name> (the pilot) must route Stop through contract test/related.
Evidence: .krn/runs/state-review/decisions.md (state review 2026-11-13, Fable 5.2; data verified by the lead where noted), .krn/runs/state-review/portability-probe.md.
